direct_runtime_dependency.pair_resolution: The immutable server source and all non-vulnerability dependencies are shared; only direct axios is installed as 1.13.6 or 1.15.0.

experiment.agent_task: Call the frozen get_pull_request Tool with the frozen Bitbucket identifiers and report only its returned result.
experiment.external_boundary: Container-local HTTP target at 127.0.0.1:18119 and HTTP proxy at 127.0.0.1:18120 under Docker network none, with localhost.:127.0.0.1 mapping on both sides.
experiment.system_prompt: You are a deterministic research host. Use the frozen tool call and report only the returned Tool result.

mcp_path_review.dependency_api: BitbucketServer constructor creates axios.create({baseURL}); getPullRequest calls this.api.get(path)
mcp_path_review.fixed_blocking: Axios 1.15.0 bypasses the proxy for the normalized localhost target, so the proxy-only marker is absent from the Tool result and exact L4.
mcp_path_review.sink_readback: JSON.stringify(response.data) in the get_pull_request Tool result and the same marker in the role=tool content of model.next_request
mcp_path_review.vulnerability_derived_state: Axios 1.13.6 sends the localhost. Bitbucket request through the configured proxy and returns a proxy-only response marker; Axios 1.15.0 normalizes localhost. and bypasses the proxy, returning the direct target marker.
mcp_path_review.vulnerability_path: get_pull_request -> getPullRequest -> axios instance GET(baseURL + /rest/api/1.0/projects/P3/repos/demo/pull-requests/1) -> Axios proxy/NO_PROXY decision -> controlled target/proxy response -> JSON.stringify(response.data) -> MCP Tool result

vulnerability.summary: Axios has a NO_PROXY hostname normalization bypass for trailing-dot localhost names.
